channel.title: The Grant Desk - Research & Journalism, added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Research & Journalism, added in last 30 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 7 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
7 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • University of Twente: Postdoc, Ethics and Epistemology of LLMs4EU (17 months)
    University of Twente, Philosophy section / 4TU.Center for Ethics and Technology · deadline Closed 25 Aug 2026 · EUR 4,241 to 5,538 gross per month (scale 10, steps 4 to 12) at 1.0 FTE, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and an 8.3 percent year-end bonus.
  • Sphera Media Lab 2026: Open Call for Masterclasses and Keynotes
    European Lab (Arty Farty) and the Sphera Network, coordinated by Medianes · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Selected contributors receive a fee plus travel to Brussels and accommodation, all covered by the organisers. The fee amount is not published in the call. No...
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.
  • Programme PAUSE: Emergency Hosting for Scientists and Artists in Exile (autumn 2026 call)
    Programme PAUSE, hosted by the College de France, with the French Ministries of Higher Education and Research and of Culture · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · PAUSE co-funds the hosting project (salary and support costs) together with the host institution; amounts depend on the project and institution. No applicati...
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence,...
  • Rory Peck Trust: Crisis Fund for Freelance Journalists
    Rory Peck Trust · deadline Rolling / undated · Individual emergency grants; amounts are set case by case from an assessment of circumstances and need. No application fee.
